Beast Wrestler.name: Beast Wrestler
Beast Wrestler.summary:
War of the Manmade Monsters!

Life Science industries of the future have created the world's greatest sports warriors. Averaging 25 feet tall and weighing several tons each, these gigantic wrestlers grapple for the ultimate championship!

Control your own titanic beast and master the various deathblow techniques. Use prize money to beef up your giant or enroll him in battle training events. Work with a Life Science team to create the most powerful fighter ever built by man!

-Choose from a variety of bizarre and mighty Super Beasts!
-Defeat the domestic champion to take on World-ranked players.
-1 or 2 player earth-shaking, blockbusting action!

Madden NFL 95.name: Madden NFL 95
Madden NFL 95.summary:
Play exhibition, Super Bowl, playoffs or full season with any of the 1994 teams or all Madden teams.

This time around, you can select whether or not to include weather conditions, new player animations (high steppin', QB slides), a bigger field and over 100 injuries.

Also includes windowless passing, all new Madden-designed strategies and team match-up that shows how your players stack up to the other team in their position.

Papi Commando - Second Blood.name: Papi Commando: Second Blood
Papi Commando - Second Blood.summary:
Papi (Grandpa) is back and angrier than ever! Help him find his beloved Commostrad, alone or in co-op mode with his wife, Mami (Grandma) Commando. 
 
Fight the terrible C++ forces through more than 100 missions across 10 stages until the final battle against the infamous Colonel KassTaGoul (also known as Colonel BreakYaFace)!
